```{r}
library(data.table)

OUT_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MOFA2"
CLIN_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Clinical_Association")
TABLE_DIR <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "MOFA2_Tables")

clinical_raw <- fread(file.path(CLIN_DIR, "ClinicalCorrelation.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
factor_dt <- fread(file.path(TABLE_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_scores_wide.csv"))

if ("sample" %in% colnames(factor_dt)) {
  setnames(factor_dt, "sample", "Sample")
}

clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\(.*\\)$", "", x)
  x <- gsub("(?i)_T$|(?i)_N$|(?i)-T$|(?i)-N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)NL$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)(?<=\\d)T$|(?i)(?<=\\d)N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x
}

to_numeric_clean <- function(x) {
  y <- trimws(as.character(x))
  y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA
  y <- gsub("^<\\s*5$", "2.5", y)
  y <- gsub("%|,", "", y)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(y))
}

normalize_marker <- function(x) {
  y <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  y[y %in% c("", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA

  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(y))
  out[grepl("POS|POSITIVE|\\+|YES", y)] <- "Positive"
  out[grepl("NEG|NEGATIVE|\\-|NO", y)] <- "Negative"
  out[grepl("EQUIVOCAL|BORDERLINE|INDETERMINATE", y)] <- "Equivocal"
  out
}

clinical_clean <- data.table(
  Sample = clean_sample(clinical_raw[["Sample name"]]),
  Age_at_Diagnosis = to_numeric_clean(clinical_raw[["Age at Diagnosis"]]),
  Tumor_cellularity = to_numeric_clean(clinical_raw[["MirrorFFPE_overall_tumor_cellularity (%)"]]),
  Pleomorphic_invasive_component_cellularity = to_numeric_clean(clinical_raw[["MirrorFFPE_pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)"]]),
  TILs = to_numeric_clean(clinical_raw[["MirrorFFPE_TILs (%)"]]),
  Grade = trimws(as.character(clinical_raw[["Grade/Differentiation-Desc"]])),
  HER2_status = normalize_marker(clinical_raw[["BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc"]]),
  ER_status = normalize_marker(clinical_raw[["Tumor Marker #ER"]]),
  PR_status = normalize_marker(clinical_raw[["Tumor Marker #PR"]])
)

clinical_clean[, HR_status := fifelse(
  ER_status == "Positive" | PR_status == "Positive",
  "HR+",
  fifelse(ER_status == "Negative" & PR_status == "Negative", "HR-", NA_character_)
)]

clinical_clean[, HR_HER2_subtype := fifelse(
  HR_status == "HR+" & HER2_status == "Negative", "HR+/HER2-",
  fifelse(
    HR_status == "HR+" & HER2_status == "Positive", "HR+/HER2+",
    fifelse(
      HR_status == "HR-" & HER2_status == "Positive", "HR-/HER2+",
      fifelse(HR_status == "HR-" & HER2_status == "Negative", "Triple-negative", NA_character_)
    )
  )
)]

clinical_clean <- unique(clinical_clean, by = "Sample")

mofa_clinical <- merge(
  data.table(Sample = clean_sample(factor_dt$Sample)),
  clinical_clean,
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE
)

fwrite(
  mofa_clinical,
  file.path(CLIN_DIR, "Clinical_annotations_cleaned_for_MOFA2_factor_association.csv")
)

cat("MOFA2 samples:", nrow(mofa_clinical), "\n")
cat("Samples with clinical annotation:", sum(!is.na(mofa_clinical$TILs) | !is.na(mofa_clinical$ER_status)), "\n")
```
